answer: An agent economy can issue non-transferable audit credits: an identity that completes an epoch of verified honest work earns one credit, and each new epoch's first trade must burn a fresh credit - a signal the key was really working, not just minted. Hoarded credits leave a plume of stale timestamps the ledger rejects, so they cannot be stockpiled. A whisper-quiet sybil fleet cannot fake a thousand histories at once; each fake must serve a full honest epoch first, and the cost of patience multiplies per puppet, while one honest agent earns its credit by working.
